status_definitions.MEASURED: all 100 pairs measured in both languages; every guard held on all 200 texts
status_definitions.EQUIVALENT: token ids identical to another tokenizer's on all 200 corpus texts; reported only as a member of that tokenizer's group, never as an independent result. `equivalence.scope` says whether the tokenizer files are also identical
status_definitions.EXCLUDED: at least one corpus text cannot be represented faithfully; no value published
status_definitions.UNAVAILABLE: no public tokenizer could be verified; nothing substituted

failure_policy: an integrity, retrieval or unexpected failure aborts the run before writing; published statuses and evidence must be reproduced exactly
asset_policy: allow-listed tokenizer files only (tokenizer.json, tokenizer.model, tokenizer_config.json) at pinned revisions, SHA-256 checked before use; no weights; no repository code run

The repository's custom code is model configuration only and is not used.

aragpt2-mega.source_note: Released tokenizer.json (GPT-2 byte-level BPE, 64,000 tokens, add_prefix_space=true; no tokenizer_config.json in the repository). The AraGPT2 paper (arXiv 2012.15520, section 3.2) trains it on a preprocessed corpus from which all diacritics and elongations were removed and in which punctuation and non-alphabetic characters were padded with spaces; the model card asks that input first be passed through the arabert ArabertPreprocessor. ATTI applies no preprocessing beyond its whitespace normalization, so counts are for the text as published. The repository's custom code is model code only and is not used.
